scope: Buyer focused summary of public software product changes and recurring themes from vendor announcements.
editorialPolicy: Updates are selected for product relevance. Affiliate status, commission and partner relationships do not influence inclusion or placement.

themes.title: AI agents are becoming reusable team workflows
themes.summary: Recent releases point toward reusable skills, shared AI behaviour and workflows that teams can invoke repeatedly instead of starting from a blank chat.

themes.title: Business software is opening up to agent connections
themes.summary: MCP, integrations and related connection layers are making software easier for AI tools and external systems to work with directly.

themes.title: Work apps are absorbing more automation
themes.summary: Product updates increasingly combine core work, automation and AI in the same product experience, reducing the distance between planning and execution.

updates.label: Official release
updates.title: Notion 3.7 adds shared Agent skills
updates.summary: Notion now lets teams create reusable AI skills, keep them in a shared library and run them from Agent conversations.

updates.label: Official product update
updates.title: HubSpot publishes new MCP server updates
updates.summary: HubSpot has published an update covering its MCP server and related AI integration tooling.
